name: Catena Media plc
customer_base_segment: B2B/B2B2C: sells player leads and traffic to licensed operators; North America (98% of group revenue) is now the core geography
business_model_notes: SEO/content and paid-media affiliate marketing for sports betting and casino, monetized via CPA/revenue-share deals with operators; recently diversifying into sub-affiliation network fees (MRKTPLAYS/MRKTPLAYS+) and paid media/CRM channels beyond organic search.
foundation_model_approach: Built and then discontinued a JV generative-AI content-production tool (MVP Feb 2024, JV wound down/bought out Jan 2025, recovering EUR 0.7m of the investment, EUR 1.2m impairment); AI now framed as a general content/scaling enhancer, not a proprietary model effort
gen_ai_platform_partnerships: Former specialist-AI JV partner for content generation (name not disclosed, venture discontinued Jan 2025); no current disclosed gen-AI platform partnership
existing_partnerships: Operator commission/CPA partners across NA sportsbook and casino brands; MRKTPLAYS+ sub-affiliate/publisher partners (working-capital and minority-equity participation offered to partners)
revenue_traction: Q1 2026 revenue EUR 12.3m (+26% YoY); Q4 2025 revenue EUR 15.6m (+53% YoY), adj. EBITDA EUR 4.7m; North America ~98% of group revenue by year-end 2025
w_notes: CEO says AI is 'uprooting' affiliate model; must become direct destination
Discontinued its only AI bet (content-gen JV) after ~1 year
Operator CPA deals plus new sub-affiliate network partners only
MRKTPLAYS/MRKTPLAYS+ sub-affiliation platform shipped; AI content tool failed/closed
Owns SEO/organic intent traffic, but CTR collapsing under AI Overviews
d_notes: Aggregates odds/offers content only; no owned betting product
No PAM/wallet/trading rail; pure marketing/lead-gen tech stack
No gambling licence itself; media/marketing entity only
No payments or MoR role; monetized via operator commissions
North America-focused (98% of revenue); narrowed from prior global footprint
Recognized affiliate brand in NA niche, not a betting brand players trust with money
ai_notes: Only AI bet (content-gen JV) built then discontinued within a year
No agentic assistant capability shipped or planned found
Content/SEO targeting per-segment, not proven individual-level personalization
Deep affiliate-funnel conversion data across NA operators, moderately useful
Pure consumer/failed experimenter of gen-AI tools, not an ecosystem partner
f_notes: Small-cap turnaround story; no fresh funding round found, self-funded from ops
Returned to double-digit growth and rising EBITDA margin (22% Q1 2026) after a slump
Senior bonds fully redeemed June 2025; leverage target 0-1.75x net debt/EBITDA
No outstanding bond debt since June 2025 redemption; low leverage
Micro-cap (~SEK 200-280m) with limited public capital-raising leverage
evidence_notes: Financials well documented via own investor releases and trade press through Q1 2026. Strategic/AI commentary from CEO Manuel Stan corroborated across multiple outlets, though the fullest interview (EGR) is paywalled so only headline framing could be captured, not direct quotes.
impact_on_incumbent_line: Willing but structurally unable: the clearest 'affiliate under AI-search attack' case in the set — explicitly reshaping itself around AI disruption of its own channel, but has no licence, product or wallet and its own AI content bet already failed.
residual_gap: No licence, betting product, or payments/MoR capability; its AI investment record (one JV, discontinued in ~a year) is thin, and its core organic-search channel is the one AI answer engines are actively eating.
notes: Legal entity Catena Media plc, Malta-incorporated, Nasdaq Stockholm-listed (CTM). Divested esports assets (esports.net, esportsbet.com) in Q2 2025 and cut headcount ~25% in a 2025 rightsizing; now near-exclusively a North America sports betting/casino affiliate business (98% of revenue). Market cap conflicting across sources (SEK 187.99m per stockanalysis.com mid-June 2026 vs SEK 278.39m at a more recent date) — reported ~USD 27m using an approx. 10.4 SEK/USD rate; treat as directional, not precise.
